notes: No source patches were applied. The only build deviation is -Dexec.skip=true, which skips saturn-console-web's npm-config/npm install/npm run build exec steps (the frontend bundle is not needed for API verification).

Ports 18205 and 2181 on the host loopback were already held by a stale Saturn console (pid 1193521) left running by an earlier, unrelated verification run in .../vipshop_Saturn-20260929T171756Z-8d43935c. It was not stopped or used. This run's console was started in a private unprivileged user+network namespace (unshare -rn) with its own loopback, so it bound 127.0.0.1:18205 and 127.0.0.1:2181 there without conflict; all requests were issued from inside that namespace via nsenter (scripts/nsrun.sh).

The console was started twice: run 1 (evidence archived under raw/run1-no-sqltrace) and run 2 with MyBatis DEBUG SQL tracing. Both produced the same outcomes; results cite run 2. Each start used a fresh in-memory H2 database.
Both console processes started by this run were stopped (verified with kill -0); no process started by this run remains. The stale console pid 1193521 from the other run is still running, untouched.

Side effect outside the workspace: during build attempt 1 the upstream saturn-console-web/npm-config.sh ran 'npm config set registry https://registry.npm.taobao.org' and 'npm config set sass_binary_site ...', which rewrote ~/.npmrc (mtime 2026-09-29 20:10:44). Reverting it was denied by the sandbox permission policy, so it was left as-is. The user should restore their npm registry setting (e.g. 'npm config delete registry; npm config delete sass_binary_site').
H2 runs in MODE MySQL (db/h2/global.sql). In H2 1.4.192 this makes NULL on NOT NULL columns be stored as ''/0 instead of rejected, which weakens the declared NOT NULL predicates at runtime.

Authentication/authorization are disabled by default (application.properties). The admin/admin seed account was logged in to obtain a session user name; one case deliberately used an anonymous session.
